data.comment: Fix attempt 2 (producer rejection of 85d23dbb): Live probe reproduced the rejection exactly — the HUD coin total stayed at the pre value for ~90% of the choreography and only counted in the final collection burst (~0.4–0.8s), and the Reputation total never moved in a normal turn (300→300 while state gained +3).

data.author: Map
data.comment:
Fix description: The previous build only counted the HUD totals at the final grid->HUD collection burst (the last phase of the choreography), so a typical turn showed a frozen total for ~6s followed by a sub-second count-up — indistinguishable from 'the total appears at the end'. Reputation never counted at all in a normal turn (only the final snap moved it).

Fix:
- Coins now count as they accrue during each phase (base count-out, synergy line landings, reputation/event fly-ins, negative-event fly-outs), so the HUD visibly builds through the whole choreography.
- Reputation now counts in step with the reputation-phase coin flights (income reputation, excluding the incident share flown in the upcoming phase).
- The grid-to-HUD collection is now a pure visual delivery of already-counted coins; the exact post-reconciliation value is still snapped at the last landing (AC5b).
- Live browser regression tests added (tests/main-street/hud-total-counting-live.browser.test.ts) that drive a REAL end turn and sample the HUD mid-choreography — this is exactly the scenario the producer reported as broken.
